description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching employee language records in the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base 'FilterParams' class, includes properties for employee number and language IDs, and sets default sorting based on language name.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for encapsulating search filter parameters specifically for filtering employee language records, including employee number and language IDs, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the filter params, setting default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns the array of language IDs used as a filter.

methods.name: setLanguageIds
methods.description: Sets the array of language IDs to filter by.
